item.title: Eni signs long-term LNG sale agreement with BOTAS
item.description: Eni has entered a long-term LNG sale agreement with BOTAS to supply 0.4 million tpy of LNG.

item.title: Newbuild LNG vessels for QatarEnergy named
item.description: Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha, Ltd has held a naming ceremony for two 174 000 m3 LNG vessels for QatarEnergy at HD Hyundai Heavy Industries Co., Ltd.

item.title: Squadron Energy chooses Reganosa to operate and maintain new LNG terminal in Australia
item.description: Reganosa Servicios has been chosen by Squadron Energy to operate and maintain the onshore part of the Port Kembla Energy Terminal, New South Wales, Australia.

item.title: Axpo and GNV complete first ship-to-ship bio-LNG refuelling in Italy
item.description: Axpo and GNV supported by the Maritime Authority of Genoa, have completed Italy's first ship-to-ship bio-LNG bunkering operation at the Port of Genoa.

item.title: Texas LNG signs binding offtake agreement with Macquarie
item.description: Glenfarne Group’s Texas LNG project has signed a definitive 20-year sales and purchase agreement with Macquarie Energy LLC for 0.5 million tpy of LNG.

item.title: Eni signs long-term LNG sale agreement with Thai Gulf Development Company
item.description: Eni has entered into a long-term LNG sales agreement with Thailand’s Gulf Development Company for 0.8 million tpy.

item.title: JERA signs long-term LNG supply agreement with Torrent Power
item.description: JERA has announced the signing of its first long-term LNG sale and purchase agreement with Torrent Power Ltd to supply LNG to India.

item.title: Fluor and JGC Corp. hands over second production train to LNG Canada
item.description: Fluor and JGC Corp. have marked the completion of the first phase of Canada’s first LNG project with the handover of Train 2 for the LNG Canada project in Kitimat, British Columbia.

item.title: POSCO International and Glenfarne finalise Alaska LNG partnership
item.description: Glenfarne Alaska LNG, LLC and POSCO International Corp. have signed definitive agreements finalising the formation of a strategic partnership for the development of the Alaska LNG project.

item.title: Conrad Shipyard and Samsung Heavy Industries announce MoU to advance US bunkering
item.description: Conrad Shipyard, LLC and Samsung Heavy Industries Co., Ltd have announced the signing of a memorandum of understanding that formalises a collaborative framework to jointly explore opportunities in the rapidly expanding US LNG bunkering market.
